caption: The drawing depicts a metallic pitcher placed on a round tray. The pitcher has a tall and slightly conical body with a smooth, reflective surface, depicted in shades of gray to black using shading techniques to create a metallic appearance. The spout is short and angled outward on the left side of the pitcher, while the handle is ornate, curving broadly on the right side before looping inward at the bottom. The lid of the pitcher is rounded and features an elaborate finial shaped like a floral or leafy ornament at the top. The tray beneath the pitcher is oval with a thick, twisted rope-like edge, and it is shaded to indicate a flat horizontal surface. The entire composition is rendered in black and white on a plain background. The artist's signature, "Eugene J. Barrell," is visible in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Pewter Flagon
